senses.gloss: m. (מָלַל II) crushing tool, press-beam (or stone) for olives; mill.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 4:5">B. Bath. IV, 5</cite>; expl.
<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 3:13">Tosef. Ter. III, 13</cite> <he>ניתן לתוך המ׳ ומהלך וכ׳</he> when he puts them in the mill and walks over them crosswise; Y. ib. III, 42ᵇ top <he>תחת המ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:7">Maasr. I, 7</cite> <he>מבין המ׳</he> Mish. ed. (Bab. ed. <he>מבית המ׳</he>; Y. ed. a. Ms. M. <he>מן המ׳</he>) from the pulp under the press; Tosef. ib. I, 7 <he>המאמל</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>הממל</he>, <he>המָלוּל</he>).
